:::{#exr-subspace-practice}
#### Testing whether the vectors with a nonnegative second entry form a subspace

A constraint such as "every entry is at least $0$" cuts out a [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-set) of vectors,
and it is worth knowing whether that set is a [subspace](#def-subspace).
Let

$$
\mathcal{H} = \cb{(x, y) \in \reals^2 : y \ge 0},
$$

the vectors whose second entry is nonnegative,
so that they form the set $\mathcal{H}$.

Is $\mathcal{H}$ a subspace of $\reals^2$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Check condition 2 of @def-subspace
with $c = -1$.

:::

:::
